affine: existing affine_fit on fresh inner-refit OOF and outer-training eligible point/bounds only; slope[.8,1.2],intercept[-.25,.25],identity ties

auxiliary.shuffle: whole four-value plus four-mask bundle within each actual fitting population; never assessment/stopping donors

budgets.recovery: No existing run directory resumed; failed costs retained, no interrupted fit continuation
budgets.uncertain_child_accounting: Timeout/kill charges max(reaped CPU, elapsed wall times enforced24CPUcap); surcharge retained in live/program/retry CPU budgets

direct_mask: unchanged legacy training_mask; metric population remains separate

features.descriptor_scaling: fitting-only finite median imputation and median/IQR; zero IQR scale1; all-missing center0 scale1; no clipping

folds.inner_refit: fresh initialization and training-only preprocessing on all inner training at selected epoch
folds.outer_refit: fresh initialization and preprocessing on all outer training at median three selected epochs
folds.stopping: fold0 of fitting-only balanced_group_folds5; availability balanced; unsupported endpoints fail
folds.stopping_metric: four-task mean direct MAE in pIC50 on eligible stopping rows; strict improvement min_delta0 earliest tie, patience20

loss: equally average supported tasks within direct/auxiliary families; empty family differentiable zero; direct MAE weight1, auxiliary Huber delta1 weight.25; direct arm auxiliary weight0
randomness: sha256-derived model/batch/dropout/shuffle/stop streams; arm excluded; identical eight heads and common batch/dropout prefix across arms
release_scope: Independent comparator first. Qualified model requires separately authorized full-development threefold stopping+refit OOF (6 joint fits), 4 OOF affine fits and 1 final joint network fit, checkpoint reload and actual blinded predictions. Never transform historical MAE CSV.
variant_selection: Require both seeds. Shuffled control never eligible. Choose lower first-repeat primary among qualified direct/real raw/affine; exact ties direct before real before shuffled, then raw before affine. No outcome-driven repair/tuning.
